not_checked.why: Held by the generator's provider; obtainable only through a lawful request.

cautions: A generator family is a lead about HOW the media was made. It does not show who made it or who posted it.
No watermark, metadata or classifier hit does not mean the media is real: most generators sign nothing and every platform strips metadata.
next_steps: Look for an earlier copy of the media: the earliest copy is the most likely to still carry a manifest or metadata.
If Hive has not run, run it: it is the only source classifier available.
